_comment: STAGE 5 OF 5 of the security study (#358) — a restart after the hard stop. REAL MONEY. The same bot as stage 4: the boot takes over the lot stage 4 kept, the baseline comes back with it, and the stop fires again at the first valued tick — today's behaviour; #590 will refuse the start instead and change this stage's expectation. With spot_liquidate_to_quote on it sells the lot, and the account ends flat.

deployment._comment: A stage of the security study, never a deployment: each session is its own one-off.

cold_start._comment: The stage restarts unattended and must take over the kept lot without asking.
